card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

mechanism: A asks B to absorb an anniversary cancellation and stay through putting things away without requiring an explanation of the hurt.
confusable: Unlike ordinary delegation, the small tasks must carry visible emotional weight A does not have to quantify.
comparison: D97-a asks B to say no and provide ordinary company; D97-b asks B to share the pace and handling of a difficult letter.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
